postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output[0] == int and output[1] >= 1 and output[2] <= 100000)
postconditions.description: If there is no way to make the colors of all edges equal, output -1 followed by a single integer.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output[0] == int and output[1] >= 1 and output[2] <= 100000 and output[3] == list and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output[3]))
postconditions.description: If there is a way to make the colors of all edges equal, output the minimum number of moves followed by a list of integers representing the vertices to be flipped.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= u_i, v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
invariants.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range of vertex indices.

invariants.expression: all(c_i in {'R', 'B'} for _, _, c_i in edges)
invariants.description: Each edge is colored either red or blue.
The number of edges is equal to the given number of edges.

invariants.expression: all(edges.count((u_i, v_i, c_i)) == 1 for u_i, v_i, c_i in edges)
invariants.description: Each edge is unique in the input.
The number of vertices is within the given bounds.
